The core profit was in line with our estimate but below the consensus by 20%. Result highlights MINT’s overall hotel and mixed -use revenue ( 79% of its top -line) increased 6% YoY for 1Q26, led by an 8% YoY mean room rate increase. Overall portfolio RevPar increased 7% YoY. The improved hotel operations were across the board from properties in Europe, Latin America, Maldives and Thailand. 1Q26 QSR sales ( 21% of the top -line) grew 2% YoY. Same-store sales dipped 0.8% YoY, led south by SSS declined in Australia (-1.4%YoY) and Singapore (-3.7% YoY), while SSS in Thailand was broadly flat YoY and up 8.6% YoY in China. Outlook We expect 2Q26 core profit to grow slightly YoY and QoQ (driven mainly by hotel performance in EU and lower interest expense). What’s changed? We maintain our 2026 earnings forecast and our YE26 DCF-based target price. Recommendation MINT remains our top sector pick for its strong good fundamentals and solid hotel and QSR brands. Our BUY call stands.
